model_annotations.Bulgarian: Диаграмата показва сравнение на точността (%) на различни модели в три различни задачи: Mathverse, MMLU и Physics, като точността е измерена в проценти. Вертикалната ос представлява точността в проценти, с диапазон от 50 до 62, маркирана с интервали от 2 единици, а хоризонталната ос показва трите задачи, разположени в азбучен ред. Всяка задача има група от пет стълба, всеки от които представлява един модел, като цветовете и текстурите на стълбовете съответстват на легендата: DAPO+Self-reflection (син със светли сини хоризонтални линии), GRPO (оранжев с дигонални линии), DAPO (светлосин с хоризонтални линии), PPO+Self-reflection (зелен със зелени диагонални линии) и SRPO (оранжев с вертикални линии). Стълбовете са подредени по реда на моделите във всяка група, като визуално се вижда, че в задачата Physics стълбовете са най-високи, а в Mathverse – най-ниски, като най-високият стълб е на DAPO+Self-reflection в задачата Physics, достигащ над 61%, а най-ниските стълбове са на DAPO в Mathverse и PPO+Self-reflection в Mathverse, около 53%.
model_annotations.Chinese: The bar chart displays the accuracy percentages of various models across three different domains: Mathverse, MMLU, and Physics. The vertical axis represents accuracy in percentage, ranging from 50% to 62% with increments of 2%, while the horizontal axis lists the three domains. For each domain, there are five distinct bars, each representing a different model or combination of models, with their respective accuracy values. The models are identified in the legend as DAPO+Self-reflection (solid blue), GRPO (orange with diagonal stripes), DAPO (light blue with diagonal stripes), PPO+Self-reflection (solid green), and SRPO (orange). In the Mathverse domain, the accuracy values are approximately 53.5% for DAPO+Self-reflection, 54.5% for GRPO, 53.5% for DAPO, 55% for PPO+Self-reflection, and 56% for SRPO. In the MMLU domain, the accuracies are approximately 57% for DAPO+Self-reflection, 56% for GRPO, 56% for DAPO, 55% for PPO+Self-reflection, and 57.5% for SRPO. In the Physics domain, the accuracies are approximately 61% for DAPO+Self-reflection, 58% for GRPO, 57.5% for DAPO, 57.5% for PPO+Self-reflection, and 60.5% for SRPO. The bars are grouped by domain, with the models presented in the same order within each group, and the chart does not visually emphasize any specific bar through style changes like shadows or outlines.
model_annotations.English: The bar chart displays the accuracy (%) of various models across three different domains: Mathverse, MMLU, and Physics. The vertical axis represents accuracy percentage, ranging from 50% to 62% with a scale interval of 2%. The horizontal axis lists the three domains. For each domain, six models are compared: DAPO+Self-reflection (solid blue), GRPO (orange with diagonal lines), DAPO (light blue with diagonal lines), SRPO (solid orange), PPO+Self-reflection (solid green), and PPO (light green with diagonal lines). In the Mathverse domain, DAPO+Self-reflection achieves the highest accuracy at approximately 56%, followed by SRPO at about 55.8%, while DAPO has the lowest at around 53.2%. In MMLU, DAPO+Self-reflection again leads with an accuracy of about 57%, followed by SRPO at approximately 57.1%, and PPO+Self-reflection at around 56%. In the Physics domain, DAPO+Self-reflection reaches the highest accuracy at about 60.8%, followed closely by SRPO at approximately 60.5%, and PPO+Self-reflection at around 59.2%. The chart shows that DAPO+Self-reflection consistently performs well, often achieving the highest or near-highest accuracy in each domain.
model_annotations.German: Das Balkendiagramm zeigt die Genauigkeit (in Prozent) verschiedener Modelle auf drei verschiedenen Datensätzen: Mathverse, MMLU und Physics. Die horizontale Achse repräsentiert die drei Datensätze, während die vertikale Achse die Genauigkeit in Prozent von 50 bis 62 anzeigt, mit einer Skala, die in Schritten von 2 Prozentpunkten markiert ist. Für jeden Datensatz sind sechs Balken gruppiert, die jeweils einem Modell oder einer Modellvariante entsprechen, wie in der Legende angegeben: DAPO+Self-reflection (blau), GRPO (orange mit diagonalen Strichen), DAPO (hellblau mit diagonalen Strichen), SRPO (orange), PPO+Self-reflection (dunkelgrün) und PPO (hellgrün mit diagonalen Strichen). Die Balken sind für jeden Datensatz nebeneinander angeordnet, wobei die Reihenfolge der Modelle innerhalb jeder Gruppe konstant bleibt. Die höchsten Genauigkeitswerte werden für das Modell DAPO+Self-reflection auf dem Physics-Datensatz (ca. 60,5 %) und für SRPO auf dem Physics-Datensatz (ca. 60,3 %) erreicht, während die niedrigsten Werte für DAPO auf dem Mathverse-Datensatz (ca. 53 %) und für PPO+Self-reflection auf dem Mathverse-Datensatz (ca. 54,5 %) liegen. Die Balken sind nicht sortiert, sondern angeordnet entsprechend den Datensätzen und den Modellbezeichnungen in der Legende, und es gibt keine visuellen Hervorhebungen wie Schattierungen oder Fettdruck.
